shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a yellow shirt sits in the pinboard-side window seat and asks to hear the full account from the beginning, while a man in a purple shirt sits in the entrance-side window seat and a man in a red shirt sits in the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt in the pinboard-side window seat swaps seats with the man in a purple shirt in the entrance-side window seat, and he answers that every detail is recorded.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a yellow shirt requests to examine the evidence.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
